This bitcoin wallet didn't move for 11 years. Then on May 13, it was empty 👀

The owner says he got stoned, changed his password and forgot it, with about $400K inside. He gave Claude his old hard drives and notebook photos, and Claude found an old backup of the wallet.

I checked the wallet myself on mempool.space: 5 BTC in on April 1, 2015, then out on May 13, 2026.

Claude didn't hack anything. It searched his own files. (And never paste a seed phrase into any AI chat.)

Claude Code isn't tired after an hour. Its context is full 🧠

I checked my own logs: after one hour, my typical session held almost half a million tokens. The docs say it plainly, performance drops as the context fills up.

The fix is 4 commands: /context to see what fills it, /compact with what to keep, /clear for a new task, /resume to get the old chat back.

Comment CONTEXT and I'll send you all four.

#claudecode #claude #ai #coding #vibecoding
claude code isn't getting dumber, its context is full 🧠 these 4 commands fix it #claudecode #claude #ai #coding #vibecoding

If Claude Code feels dumber after an hour, it's not tired. Its context is full. My own logs: after one hour my typical session held almost 500K tokens. /context shows what fills it, /compact keeps what matters, /clear starts fresh, /resume brings the old chat back.
alt_text: Zane explains why Claude Code gets worse in long sessions and shows the /context, /compact, /clear and /resume commands from the official docs.

People search sites can show your phone number to anyone who types your name.

So I sent a robot (read only) to 5 of their removal pages, 3 times. TruePeopleSearch, BeenVerified and FastPeopleSearch blocked it every time, before the page even loaded. Spokeo and Whitepages opened.

Anthropic says Claude in Chrome runs in your own browser and fills in forms like a person would. The captcha and the confirmation email link stay with you.

The person in the video is a fake example. If you want the exact request I used, comment ERASE and I'll send it to you.
